title: Crispy Fried Rice
description: A classic Malaysian-inspired dish made with fried rice, crunchy vegetables, and savory seasonings.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion, carrot, and pepper, and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender.
Add cooked rice to the wok or skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice mixture for about 5 minutes, until it is heated through and starting to brown.
Add soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions and a wedge of lime, if desired.
